daily_quests.title: Active Focus (เพ่งสมาธิ)
daily_quests.description: Card with text input for setting specific learning goals.

daily_quests.title: The Deep Root (โหมดจดจ่อ)
daily_quests.description: Includes a visual 90-minute countdown timer with a 15-20 minute forced rest state selector.

daily_quests.title: Brain Dump - Voice Edition
daily_quests.description: Includes a microphone button to record verbal explanations, converting speech-to-text.

daily_quests.title: Cross-Pollination (ผสมเกสรข้ามศาสตร์)
daily_quests.description: A scheduling toggle UI to switch study topics every hour.

daily_quests.title: Daily Learning Check-in
daily_quests.description: A locked grayed-out item that unlocks when 1-2 daily tasks are completed. Clicking it opens a 'Watering Can' (บัวรดน้ำ) popup.

side_quests_and_achievements.title: Time Capsule Watering (รดน้ำข้ามเวลา)
side_quests_and_achievements.description: Notification bell card for reviewing old topics based on Spacing Effect.

side_quests_and_achievements.title: Mirror of Truth
side_quests_and_achievements.description: Instant feedback action button that unlocks the 'กิ่งก้านแห่งปัญญา' item.

side_quests_and_achievements.title: The Guardian of Rest
side_quests_and_achievements.description: Multi-hour tracking bar. If work exceeds 4-5 hours, it warns the user with a withered tree preview to prevent burnout.

side_quests_and_achievements.title: Ten-Year Forest
side_quests_and_achievements.description: A continuous login streak calendar tracker.

physical_health.category: ด้านสุขภาพกาย
physical_health.impact: พัฒนา 'ใบไม้' (Leaves Growth)

daily_quests.title: Calorie Tracking (นับแคลอรี่)
daily_quests.description: A split visual gauge bar comparing Calories In (food photo upload/caloric entry) vs Calories Out (Smartwatch integration data tracking steps and distance).

daily_quests.title: IF System (คุมเวลากิน)
daily_quests.description: A fasting clock UI showing fasting schedules (e.g., 16:8) synchronized with circadian rhythms.

daily_quests.title: Sleep Guard (การนอน)
daily_quests.description: Time picker log for sleep/wake hours. Meeting a 7-8 hour target unlocks a glowing blue shield icon labeled 'Cortisol Shield'.

daily_quests.title: Active Recovery & NEAT
daily_quests.description: A micro-timer that prompts a 5-minute stretching/walking alert automatically after a Deep Focus session ends.

physical_health.reward_effect: Glowing 'ละอองแดด (Sunlight Aura)' icon overlay that makes the 2D tree leaves glossily reflective.

mental_health.category: ด้านสุขภาพจิต
mental_health.impact: พัฒนา 'ดอกไม้' (Flowers Growth)

daily_quests.title: Daily Mood Check-in
daily_quests.description: Pop-up window appearing upon entering the game. Includes a text input box for journaling and an AI indicator showing 3 emotion levels: ดี (Good), เฉยๆ (Neutral), ไม่ดี (Bad). Bad emotional patterns trigger a gentle advice overlay. The written text dynamically converts into a Post-it note attached to the center tree.

daily_quests.title: Adaptive Guidance (ปรับสมดุลใจ)
daily_quests.description: Contextual activity cards based on mood (e.g., 1-minute deep breathing animation, Sound Therapy audio player, or a Gratitude Journal text field).

mental_health.reward_effect: Completing the Gratitude Journal triggers an animated 'ผีเสื้อแห่งความสงบ (Calm Butterfly)' asset that flies gently around the blooming flowers on the tree.

registration_and_initial_setup.mbti_selection: Interactive grid for selecting the user's MBTI type (16 personalities), where each selection previews a uniquely styled and colored starting tree variant.

health_and_analytics_metrics.bmi_card: User's Body Mass Index calculated dynamically using standard metric formulas.
health_and_analytics_metrics.user_silhouette: Dynamic 2D pseudo-3D User Silhouette illustration transforming into a fitter shape based on workout frequency and active step counts.
counters: ชั่วโมงเรียนรู้สะสม (Accumulated Learning Hours)
ก้าวเดินสะสม (Accumulated Steps/Distance synced via Smartwatch)

interactive_progress_and_mood_calendar.monthly_calendar: Interactive colored micro-indicators or dots showing how many quests were completed across the 3 categories.
interactive_progress_and_mood_calendar.mood_indicator: Cell color or emoji shifts dynamically based on mood history (ดี, เฉยๆ, ไม่ดี).
interactive_progress_and_mood_calendar.day_click_modal: Expands a modal showing past Post-it text memories and specific quest achievements.

visual_structure.main_illustration: Beautifully shaded 2D watering can (บัวรดน้ำ)

questions.question: วันนี้คุณเริ่มต้นการเรียน/ทำงานด้วยเป้าหมายที่ชัดเจนมากแค่ไหน?
คุณสามารถจดจ่ออยู่กับสิ่งที่ทำโดยไม่ถูกรบกวนได้ดีเพียงใด?
วันนี้คุณได้พยายามนึก ทบทวน หรือสรุปสิ่งที่เรียนรู้ด้วยตัวเองมากน้อยแค่ไหน?
คุณได้หยุดพักผ่อนสมองอย่างแท้จริงระหว่างช่วงเรียนหรือทำงานหรือไม่?
โดยรวมแล้ว วันนี้คุณพึงพอใจกับการพัฒนาตัวเองมากแค่ไหน?

bonus_field.label: มีอะไรที่อยากปรับปรุงให้ดีขึ้นในวันพรุ่งนี้?
bonus_field.behavior: Converts into a persistent mini Post-it note on the user interface screen.

micro_interaction_design.slider_animation: As the user slides or gives high star ratings, the water level inside the 2D watering can illustration dynamically fills up with a fluid blue color animation.
micro_interaction_design.completion_action: Upon filling out all 5 questions, the primary action button glows. Clicking it plays a visual animation of the watering can tilting and pouring water directly onto the tree's Trunk element, accompanied by a glittering light effect (แสงวิบวับ).
